newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm prices stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm prices stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were stable in late trading on Tuesday amid sluggish consumer demand, traders said.
They said the flat Malaysian market had also dampened local market sentiment. Buyers were sidelined, waiting for further developments in Malaysia, the traders said.
"It is still quiet. Consumer demand is weak and the flat market in Malaysia has dampened local sentiment," said one trader in Jakarta.
Palm olein was unchanged at 1,390-1,405 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, while crude palm oil was stable at 1,225 rupiah/kg in North Sumatran city of Medan.
"We will see what the market will be on Thursday. We also hope that demand will pick up ahead of the Eid al-Adha celebration on April 18," said one trader.
The market is closed on Wednesday for a public holiday.
